adoration.text: Holy Hour after 19:00 Mass on first Thursday monthly in Main Church.

confession.text: 30 minutes before Saturday Sunset and Sunday Masses, or arrange a time directly with a priest.

devotions.text: Sacred Heart devotion every Friday 19:45 in Church, livestreamed on Facebook/YouTube. Email petitions/thanksgiving to petitions@churchofthesacredheart.sg by Friday 17:00.
Rosary with Mary, every 13th monthly 19:30 at Mary’s Shrine.

office_hours.text: Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00, Parish Building Level 3; closed public holidays.

events.text: Stay-in retreat 16-18 Oct 2026 at the Catholic Spirituality Centre, conducted by Msgr Peter Zhang and the CSC Retreat Team. Fee $280; register at https://bit.ly/cscjdr2.

events.text: English and Mandarin; additional dated bilingual Sunday beyond normal second-Sunday rule.

events.text: Also 19:00; columbarium blessing after each Mass. Intention submission deadline 25 October.

events.text: Stay-in Catholic Encounter Retreat, 6-9 Nov 2026 at St. Francis Xavier Retreat Centre. Fee $163.50; register at tinyurl.com/oyp-treasure18 or email treasure.oyp@catholic.org.sg.

events.title: Pieta Memorial Mass 2026
events.text: At the Church of St Alphonsus (Novena Church), for families who have lost a child. Register by 30 October at https://tinyurl.com/MM2026Pieta.

events.title: OYP Outreach for Secondary 4 & 5 Students
events.text: Morning of prayer and fellowship at Catholic Centre, 55 Waterloo Street, #08-01, 10am-1pm (registration 9.45am). Free; register at tinyurl.com/SecOutreach26Nov.

church_hours.text: Open for visits 07:30–18:30, closed on public holidays (Masses are held outside these hours too).

getting_there.text: Basement/Level 1 carpark entrance via Tank Road. Levels 4/5 via Jalan Rumbia from Oxley Rise, behind church. MRT: Dhoby Ghaut or Fort Canning; buses 64, 123, 139, 143.
Parish parking map also identifies nearby public parking at Fort Canning, Tank Road, Clemenceau Avenue and UE Square; availability/fees not provided.

sacraments.text: Infant baptism first Sunday of January, March, May, July, September and November at 14:00. Application form downloadable.
Contact Parish Office directly at least one year ahead to book church and confirm presiding priest. At least one party baptised Catholic; attend EE or MPC. Wedding booking form downloadable.
Mondays 19:30–21:30; 2026/27 journey began 13 July 2026. Register via register.churchofthesacredheart.sg/rcia-2627-inquirers-registration/.
Sundays: Levels 1–6 09:00–10:00; Levels 7–9 10:00–11:30. Registration form downloadable.
Contact Parish Office; parish links Archdiocesan Funeral Policy and arrangement flowchart.
Contact Parish Office for appointment/niche application; niche application/update forms downloadable.
Email full name, birth date and baptism date to request baptismal extract. Collect personally or through family member at Parish Office.

ministries.text: Volunteers with basic PowerPoint skills prepare weekly hymn/prayer/reading slides from home. Training provided. John-Paul: operations@churchofthesacredheart.sg.
